_comment: PLACEHOLDER SPONSORS. These companies have NOT sponsored anything. They
stand in for the real list until it arrives. Replace every entry before
Editing: change this file, commit, and the next deploy picks it up.
name  (required) the sponsor's name, used as the logo's alt text and
set as type when there is no logo.
logo  (optional) a direct image URL, or a path under public/, e.g.
"/sponsors/google.svg". Leave it out and the name is shown instead.
url   (optional) where clicking the logo goes. Opens in a new tab.
The band scrolls in the order listed here.
